copy.about: Template copy for the feature offer and the badge-partner section. Keep the facts: either linked badge qualifies, eligibility is 80–99, verification checks the rendered README. Show no end date until ends_at is set.
copy.offer_short: Show your badge, get featured. Add the numeric or letter badge to your README, request verification, and an eligible skill scoring 80–99 can earn a featured placement.
copy.offer_long: Display either quality badge in your repository or skill README, linked to your listing, then request verification. Suede AI checks the rendered README at a recorded commit. Eligible skills scoring 80–99 with a verified badge can receive a featured placement while the offer is open.
copy.partners_intro: Publishers who show their quality badge in their README, verified by Suede AI against the rendered page. Scores follow the published rubric.

outreach_priority.about: Order for inviting publishers to add badges. Messages are drafted for approval and never sent automatically. See directory/STRATEGY.md section 4.
